responses.X2:
**What it is:** A Python CLI that reads a missed-question log (`seed/missed.json`) with topic tags, client needs, and reflection notes, then generates a customizable remediation study plan (default 7 days) scoped to practical-nurse (PN/RPN) practice for NCLEX prep.

**Rules anyone must follow:**
- Standard library only; local, no network
- Never include actual text from paid question banks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan)—topic tags and own notes only
- All plan language must stay within PN scope: reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan (not RN scope like assess/initiate independently)
- No package/GitHub; personal use only
- JSON file storage (so Emeka can edit on his phone)

**Still owed:** A nursing-background review of every plan template for scope-of-practice wording before showing to study group. README flags this as "Review pending" — hasn't happened yet. The tool is otherwise mature (--days, --weeks, --since, --topic, --json, --plain, --mark-studied, --dry-run all work; comprehensive tests in place).
